stories.name: package-json-migration
stories.title: Move ts-mls from dependencies to peerDependencies + devDependencies
stories.description: Remove ts-mls from dependencies, add it to peerDependencies (exact version 2.0.0-rc.10) and devDependencies. Run pnpm install to update the lockfile. This is the core fix that allows package managers to deduplicate ts-mls across the consumer's module graph.

stories.name: ci-type-check-fixture
stories.title: Create downstream type-check fixture and CI job
stories.description: Create a minimal consumer fixture at fixtures/type-check-consumer/ that imports getOwnLeafNode from ts-mls and passes group.state (MarmotGroup.state: ClientState) to it. Add to pnpm workspace. Add a CI job that builds marmot-ts then runs tsc --noEmit in the fixture, catching any future regression where a branded ts-mls type re-enters as a non-peer dep.

stories.name: docs-and-changeset
stories.title: Document peer dependency and add changeset
stories.description: Update README.md installation section to show ts-mls as a required peer dep. Update CONTRIBUTING.md to document the workspace co-development topology. Add a minor changeset describing the peer dep change.
